name: Zwecklhof
kurzbeschreibung: Zwecklhof distillery in Oberau, Wildschönau: award-winning fine spirits, liqueurs, gin and rum with tastings at 1,200 metres above sea level.
beschreibung:
The Zwecklhof in Oberau in the Wildschönau is a traditional mountain farm that has been cultivated for over 400 years. Since 1995, Siegfried "Sigi" Kistl has run a distillery here, producing exceptional fine spirits, liqueurs, gin and rum at 1,200 metres above sea level.

At the on-site distillery, visitors can see the modern show distillery in action and, during a tasting in the cosy Brennkammerl, enjoy noble distillates with farmhouse bread and the farm's own bacon. The spirits have won several awards, including as the overall winner of "Tiroler Edelbrand 2024". Tastings are available by appointment, including for groups. Sales are open Wednesday, Friday and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., with other times available by telephone arrangement.
